summary: Preserve the open-source Kie agent media factory: hand-written local director, durable script/storyboard production state, per-shot video preview/show/approve gates, eight-workflow CLI catalog, private reference and consented identity stores, focused stateless MCP 2026-07-28 server, current product documentation, SeedDance 2.5 routing guidance, and nine Kie skill packages across future Printing Press regenerations.
reason: The generated API CLI exposes raw Kie endpoints but does not provide the user-facing media qualification, approved master scripts and storyboards, enforced human-in-the-middle per-shot video previews, durable local handles, typed private media vault, provider-aware plan construction, token-efficient workflow discovery, focused finalized MCP 2026-07-28 surface, or agent-media-factory documentation hierarchy required for interactive image and video production. The extension deliberately lives beside the generated broad CLI/MCP code and reuses its auth/client rather than altering generated endpoint commands. Storyboard operations are local-only and create a normal child brief per shot; preview and final generation remain separate live actions, and each approved still is fingerprinted to its shot brief and becomes the SeedDance visual anchor. The README, beginner prompt, advanced contract, storyboard guide, model catalog generator, and skills must remain aligned with the installed `kie-pp-cli` command surface after reprints.
validated_outcome: Fresh verification passed: go test ./..., go vet ./..., go build ./..., targeted race tests, git diff --check, and all nine skill packages through skill-creator quick_validate.py. A full documentation audit added the GitHub ASCII product hero and agent-media-factory architecture, standardized examples on the installed kie-pp-cli binary, fixed malformed storyboard prose, documented honest provider/Higgsfield boundaries, and kept the model-catalog generator aligned. make build-all produced all three documented binaries; the referenced CLI/MCP help paths executed successfully; all local Markdown links resolve; the patch record is valid JSON; and research/build_spec.py compiles. Script/storyboard unit, CLI, and MCP tests prove local set/review/approve state, duration validation, artifact and creative-hash invalidation, zero live calls before storyboard approval, one gated child brief per shot, and rejection of prompt-only master submission. Regression tests also prove failed/nonterminal previews cannot be approved, matching active preview jobs are deduplicated across all generations, and local file errors redact parent paths. Existing tests still prove preview generation, display/approval state, SeedDance visual anchoring, regeneration, and final submission blocking. The focused stateless MCP 2026-07-28 server exposes twenty-five tools, including four model-contract inspection/validation tools and six local script/storyboard tools. Binary dogfood produced draft_script -> draft_storyboard -> generate_shot_previews, returned two shot_brief_id values, built a GPT Image 2 preview dry-run for the first shot, and rejected master submission with next_action=generate_shot_previews. Independent forward-test and code-review passes approved the CLI/MCP sequence and approval gates. cli-printing-press scorecard remains grade A / 87%. No paid/live Kie generation was submitted because the validation home had no API credential.
